records.claim: The inspected editor supports variable-width counted Events records.
records.observation: The editor advances by three tokens per event, with one additional token when its discriminator equals 2.
records.interpretation: A fixed-triplet parser can misidentify the following opcode; retain the discriminator and validate boundaries.
records.limitations: Editor framing only; no game loader, actual member or event semantics was verified.

records.claim: The inspected editor represents trigger attachment and tag references separately.
records.observation: The editor reads trigger house, attachment, name, disabled and difficulty fields; tag entries have a trigger reference and a separate type.
records.interpretation: Keep trigger and tag identities distinct and preserve raw fields until runtime latch and repeat scope is established.
records.limitations: Editor UI storage access does not establish original repeat, link traversal, event conjunction or attachment semantics.

records.claim: The inspected editor distinguishes a numbered script step type from its parameter.
records.observation: The selected step is read through a numbered key; type and parameter are separate tokens.
records.interpretation: Preserve source step identity and parameter tokens independently from runtime program-counter/wait state.
records.limitations: No original script wait, completion, interruption, recruitment or ownership behavior was observed.
